SVC_MIJIA.name: Mijia sensor
SVC_MIJIA.description: Telink/Xiaomi custom service used by LYWSD03MMC, LYWSD02, and MHO-C401

CHR_SENSOR.name: Temperature, humidity, battery
CHR_SENSOR.description: Read and notify. Mijia Reader subscribes (CCCD notifications) and takes the first payload: int16 LE temperature in 0.01°C, uint8 humidity percent, uint16 LE battery millivolts as the last two bytes.

structure.description: Little-endian, unit 0.01°C. Negative values are two's complement.
Little-endian millivolts. V2 and V4 percent is mV * 100 / 3100. V3 ignores this field.

CHR_BATTERY.name: Battery percent
CHR_BATTERY.description: V3 LYWSD02 only. First byte is battery percent. V2 and V4 take percent from the sensor notification instead.

CHR_TIME.name: Clock
CHR_TIME.description: V3 LYWSD02 read: unix time as int32 little-endian seconds, shown as HH:mm. Writing the clock is not part of this entry.
